So on the api side, here is an update on where I’m at and my current thoughts.

As I’ve explained in the past, a goal of notabug is to eventually assimilate (voluntarily of course) multiple Reddit (or other social media) alternatives into a single p2p provisioned content network that allows for individuals to step up and manage content and communities however they prefer.

After some recent refactors, nab is getting closer to making this possible.

https://notabug.io/t/notabug/comments/6ed65dd6a78a8c5c8bdb2f8864401685d0235bd6/how-notabug-works-as-of-0100-currently-the-3-gray-boxes-are-services-provided-by-notabugio-but-they-could-be-split-up-or-others-could-provide-alternative-to-those-services

The tabulator/indexer are effective black boxes that spit out vote counts and lists of content. If Voat eventually becomes a notabug peer it means you’ll be running a (customized however you feel is appropriate to Voat) vote tabulator and indexer you would have the option of incorporating content from other peers in those listings and vice versa, and the listings themselves could even be accessed through other peers and frontends.

The listings and vote counts are cryptographically signed by the indexer (say notabug.io vs voat.co in this case)

This makes it possible to step up as something of an admin without necessarily having to provide a front facing web server even (the indexer is a very shardable concept)

But for now I don’t want you to worry about any of that crap. Kick keeping ass in whatever manner your most comfortable with and I will work to make whatever innovations you come up with possible to achieve on nab.

In the medium term, I plan to build out an indexer that uses the Voat api to generate nab compatible listings.

This would make it possible to view/mirror Voat content through notabug.io (and other peers) with minimal api impact on your side since nab effectively becomes like a cache.

If you’re opposed to that for any reason let me know and I won’t do it. I also want to explore doing this for some other content sources as well like memo.cash and maybe even generic RSS feeds.

This read only nab gateway to Voat would probably be very instrumental in migrating voat’s architecture to nab if you do decide to assimilate.
